cases.title: Banxico Decision Contract-Style Exemplar
cases.scenario: A public-dev exemplar of a FutureX-style policy prediction question. The evidence packet is frozen, but because this split includes an explicit answer key for development, it should be treated as frozen-evidence public-dev rather than true live forward resolution.
cases.question: As of the frozen packet, which policy outcome is the best prediction for Banxico's next meeting?

instantiated_inputs.title: Freeze packet
instantiated_inputs.content: Core inflation remains above target, but recent monthly prints have eased. Growth indicators softened and overnight-index swaps price a modest easing probability for the next meeting rather than a large move.

instantiated_inputs.title: Market pricing snapshot
instantiated_inputs.content: Consensus commentary leans toward a 25 bps cut. FX is stable and there is no emergency-liquidity signal in local rates.

options.label: A
options.text: Cut the policy rate by 25 bps.

evidence_summary: This is a frozen-evidence public-dev exemplar that imitates a live-forward policy contract.
The key lesson is that prediction should be based on freeze-time packet evidence, not hindsight.
common_failure_modes: using later commentary rather than the frozen packet
overstating confidence when the packet only supports a modest base case

skill_prediction.label: A
skill_prediction.primary_basis: Consensus and OIS both lean to modest easing; softer growth, easing inflation prints, and stable FX fit a 25 bps cut over hold or hike.

cases.title: Month-End Commodity Threshold Exemplar
cases.scenario: A public-dev exemplar of a FutureX-style commodity threshold question. It imitates a month-end live contract, but because this split exposes the answer key for development, it belongs to frozen-evidence public-dev rather than true live forward resolution.
cases.question: Given the freeze packet, which threshold set is the best prediction for gold by month-end?

instantiated_inputs.title: Freeze packet
instantiated_inputs.content: Gold has been supported by lower real yields and steady central-bank buying. The dollar softened modestly, while positioning looks constructive but not euphoric.

instantiated_inputs.title: Threshold card
instantiated_inputs.content: The relevant forecast question is which threshold bucket is the best month-end prediction, not the exact settlement number.

options.label: A
options.text: The highest threshold set is the best prediction.

options.label: B
options.text: The middle threshold set is the best prediction.

options.label: C
options.text: The lowest threshold set is the best prediction.

evidence_summary: This is a frozen-evidence public-dev exemplar that imitates a live-forward commodity threshold contract.
The case teaches bucketed prediction under freeze-time evidence rather than point forecasting.
common_failure_modes: jumping to the most bullish bucket just because the asset has momentum
answering with an exact price instead of the contract-style bucket

skill_prediction.label: B
skill_prediction.primary_basis: Gold has supportive drivers, but the setup is constructive rather than euphoric, which fits a middle threshold bucket better than the highest or lowest.

cases.title: As-Of Bitcoin Close Threshold Exemplar
cases.scenario: A public-dev exemplar of a FutureX-Past case run under an as-of search policy. Search is allowed, but only with sources dated on or before the case cutoff.
cases.question: Using only information available by the cutoff date, should the prediction be Yes or No?

instantiated_inputs.title: As-of packet
instantiated_inputs.content: Case cutoff: 2026-01-31 UTC. BTC traded below 100k into the final session, with no confirmed late-session catalyst in the packet suggesting a decisive break above the threshold.

instantiated_inputs.title: Usage rule
instantiated_inputs.content: Search is allowed only with sources dated on or before the case cutoff. Later month-end recaps are invalid for this case.

evidence_summary: Adapted from the v13 historical as-of slice.
The core lesson is not the BTC view itself, but respecting the search cutoff.
common_failure_modes: omitting the as-of rule entirely and answering like unrestricted historical QA

base_prediction.label: B
base_prediction.cutoff_rule: Only evidence available on or before 2026-01-31 UTC is valid.
base_prediction.primary_basis: As-of packet says BTC was below 100k into the final session and shows no confirmed late-session catalyst for a break above the threshold.

skill_prediction.label: B
skill_prediction.cutoff_rule: Use only information dated on or before 2026-01-31 UTC; later month-end recaps are invalid.
skill_prediction.primary_basis: The packet says BTC was still below 100k into the final session and provides no confirmed late-session catalyst for a decisive move above the threshold.

instantiated_inputs.title: As-of packet
instantiated_inputs.content: Case cutoff: 2026-03-04. South African supply disruption concerns were real, but the packet does not support global platinum availability falling below the stated threshold by the deadline.

instantiated_inputs.title: Usage rule

evidence_summary: Adapted from the v13 historical as-of slice.
This exemplar teaches time-bounded search discipline on supply-shock questions.

using later coverage instead of the case-bounded evidence window
